command.description: Shell command whose output is shown (run through /bin/sh -c)
command.label: Command

glyph.description: Glyph shown before the text; leave empty for none
glyph.label: Glyph

hide_when_empty.description: Hide the widget when the command prints nothing
hide_when_empty.label: Hide When Empty

interval.description: Seconds between runs; the refresh IPC event re-runs it immediately
interval.label: Interval

max_chars.description: Characters of the first output line shown in the bar (0 = no limit)
max_chars.label: Max Characters
